g.text: Djilba and the mix of daily weather

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203139

g.text: Each point is one source-date record with all three measurements. SD uses all observed daily maximums in the season.
Sunshine and rainfall have different recording windows and stations: these are broad patterns, not same-hour relationships.
